notes: 1) All six 'Experimental table' CSVs in these folders are ISS flight test tables, not ground. 2) The ACME Engineering Requirements Doc, Integrated Science Requirements (ISRD/RevB), Science Operations Requirements, fact sheets, CDR package, Researcher's Guide and the SRDs are requirements/planning or background documents; their ground/1-g hits are statements of intent, literature references, or ground-unit/hardware checks. Hardware-only items (ground copy of CIR leak check, cold-flow hot-wire anemometry, UMD identical-burner igniter timing runs) are not flame condition data. 3) The only items with any 1-g O2 value: PSI-20 SRD (air, stated once) and PSI-20 dissertation Fig. 5.4 legend (XO2 0.21, p 1 bar for 4 Auth points whose primary data are in a thesis not in the files). Both are BRE gas-burner emulations, not real fuels. 4) 5 s/2.2 s drop towers and aircraft tests (BRE SRD Table 1 D9023-D9030, Figs. 7-9 heptane at 30% O2 and 2 atm, Swenson 2011, Karnani 2009 NASA part) were excluded as not_ground_drop_or_parabolic. 5) Karnani 2009 text layer is slide titles only; figures were not visually inspected, so numeric conditions printed only in an image would be missed. 6) PSI-20 RDR/SCR 2012 concept documents were only sampled by page-level snippets, not read in full.
